data.notes: May 2026 in New York is especially strong for electronic music, with C2C, WIRE, Teksupport and Under the K Bridge anchoring the club/festival calendar alongside arena pop and hip-hop dates.

events.title: Long Play Festival 2026
events.summary: Bang on a Can’s Long Play returns as a multi-day Brooklyn festival with 60+ concerts. The 2026 program includes featured sets tied to John Luther Adams, Morton Feldman, BlankFor.ms with Jason Moran and Marcus Gilmore, Secret Chiefs 3 and more.

events.title: C2C Festival NYC 2026
events.summary: Italy’s C2C Festival returns to Knockdown Center for its second New York edition across three stages. The confirmed lineup includes Arca, Avalon Emerson & The Charm, aya, Nourished by Time, Titanic, Malibu, Los Thuthanaka and YHWH Nailgun.

events.title: Peggy Gou with Mall Grab
events.summary: Peggy Gou headlines an open-air Brooklyn date at Under the 'K' Bridge Park, with Mall Grab also listed on the Ticketmaster lineup. The event is confirmed for 7:00 PM and is marked 21+.

events.title: Teksupport: Max Styler
events.summary: Teksupport presents Max Styler at Brooklyn Storehouse for a late-night 21+ event. DICE lists the show for Saturday, May 9 at 10:00 PM with doors at 10:00 PM.

events.title: WIRE Festival 2026
events.summary: WIRE Festival returns to Knockdown Center for its fifth anniversary edition from May 14–17. The RA-listed program includes MUTEK, Herrensauna, WHOLE and FOLD takeovers with Alva Noto, Dopplereffekt, Dax J, Dr. Rubinstein, Freddy K, Juliana Huxtable, Aurora Halal and many more.

events.title: The Nursery: Sofia Kourtesis, Dave DK
events.summary: public records hosts The Nursery with Sofia Kourtesis and Dave DK on Sunday, May 17. Resident Advisor lists the event as a 4:00–10:00 PM house-focused program.

events.title: Golden Record NYC x TAMED x 333 present D'JULZ, Shvili, Kiyoshi, Miguel Gallardo
events.summary: Golden Record NYC, TAMED and 333 present an East Williamsburg after-hours event led by D'JULZ, with Shvili, Kiyoshi, RAAUL, Miguel Gallardo and Etien Hai also listed. RA confirms the event runs from Friday night into Saturday morning.

events.title: René Liu: Final Call 2026 Tour
events.summary: René Liu brings the Final Call 2026 Tour to Barclays Center in Brooklyn. The venue lists the show for Saturday, May 23 at 7:00 PM.

events.title: Diljit Dosanjh: Aura World Tour 2026
events.summary: Diljit Dosanjh brings his Aura World Tour 2026 to Madison Square Garden. Ticketmaster confirms the Sunday, May 24 performance at 8:00 PM, with a second MSG date listed for May 25.

events.title: PLEXUS: Ron Like Hell & Friends
events.summary: PLEXUS returns to H0L0 with Ron Like Hell, Joton, Sploofi, Kilopatrah Jones, Lezzie, PlayPlay, skoglund and special guests. RA confirms the event runs from Sunday evening into Monday morning.

events.title: Charlie Puth: Whatever's Clever! World Tour
events.summary: Charlie Puth’s Whatever's Clever! World Tour stops at Madison Square Garden on Friday, May 29. Ticketmaster confirms the New York date at 7:30 PM.

events.title: Kid Cudi: The Rebel Ragers Tour
events.summary: Kid Cudi brings The Rebel Ragers Tour to Madison Square Garden with special guests Big Boi and A-Trak. MSG confirms the concert for Saturday, May 30 at 6:30 PM.
